canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Forge District's chapter of the book of lore, its lines the game's; the Forge District, its Warrens, the Foundry, the Spoke, the Copper-Tithe, the Rust & Ruin and the Weave-Eaters are CANON (world_bible.md; book1 ch.1, 3, 7, 16, 24), the River Aureum, the Molten Vein and the Great Crucible the author's map, as each line says.

entries.subject: The Tithe Gate
entries.more: The Tithe's gate-book has a column for what each soul owes. Most of it is the Concord's. A little of it is favours.

entries.subject: The Forge Warrens
entries.more: Elfa Raike keeps a slate of the Warrens' coughs. The 'worse since the monolith' column runs off the slate.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Forge District Warrens (book1 ch.3:159); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Spoke
entries.line: A rune-carved monolith of black stone in the middle of the Foundry, raised by the Council. It hums, and the air near it tastes of copper.
entries.more: On the ring wall round it, low down where a child would sit, a W in chalk.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Spoke, a rune-carved stone monolith (world_bible.md Magic; book1 ch.7:237)

entries.subject: The Foundry
entries.more: The Council's list of the district's bright children, graded like ore, each struck through and marked: Moved up.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Foundry District (book1 ch.7:237); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Great Crucible
entries.more: A foundry pass: stamped copper on a cord. It gets you into the yard. It does not get you out.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Great Crucible (the author's map); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Slag Fields
entries.line: Black heaps cracked with ember, tipped out of the furnaces for a hundred years.
entries.more: From the top of the tallest heap the whole district lies below in the smog, and the Crown far off over it all.

entries.subject: The River Aureum
entries.line: Molten metal running in a stone channel down from the furnaces. The heat comes off it like a wall.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the River Aureum (the author's map); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Molten Vein
entries.line: The second molten channel, crossed only by its stone bridges.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Molten Vein (the author's map); GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: The Rust & Ruin
entries.line: A tavern behind an iron-banded oak door. Stale beer, smoke, and nobody asking your name.

entries.subject: Hesta Wode
entries.line: The Copper-Tithe's tally-woman at the gate. She writes down everyone, and what they owe, and keeps a list of her own now.
entries.more: The Tithe's runners hid their takings in the district wall once. Hesta never went to look.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Copper-Tithe (book1 ch.24:140); Hesta GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Old Aelric
entries.more: Aelric's notched stick: forty years of pours, and at the end, notches that are not pours.

entries.subject: Hamo Glaze
entries.line: A slag-glass blower who makes beads out of the furnaces' leavings. Once he made one the colour of the sea.

entries.subject: Slag-hound
entries.line: Feral dogs of the slag heaps, grey with ash and burned bald in patches. They hunt the tips in packs.

entries.subject: Blackleg
entries.line: Thugs the foremen hire to keep the smelters working. They warm their hands at the fire pits and take what they like.

entries.subject: Foundry overseer
entries.line: The Council's men in the Foundry, with tally-sticks and cudgels. They count pours and children the same way.

entries.subject: Iron Pact soldier
entries.line: Soldiers of the Iron Pact, set to keep the Spoke's yard. They do not ask what the yard is for.
entries.canonStatus: CANON: the Iron Pact (world_bible.md); here GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Old Clinker
entries.line: An old slag-hound, half bald and all teeth, who has outlived three packs. The smelters' children dare each other to see him.

entries.subject: The Spoke-Leech
entries.line: A Weave-Eater grown fat on what leaks off the monolith. It drinks the glow from the runes and the breath from the Warrens.
